authorship: soccz personal follow-up; AI-assisted code/data/analysis; independent human judgments completed: 0
status: Designed after observing v4 attachment failures. New authored query-pair probes, locally frozen before fitting; not an external preregistration or an independently authored real-document benchmark.
hypothesis: Exact-query canonicalization can make target-dependent roles easier to learn; it need not solve discourse reference or transfer to real policies.

conditions.legacy_plain: Reuse v4 normalized_scope seeds, source names unchanged
conditions.legacy_marked: Same v4 weights; replace exact query occurrences with 지정사업 and canonicalize query; zero new fitting
conditions.marked: New paired-query training, exact query replaced with 지정사업 in query and passage
conditions.blind: New paired-query training, query replaced with constant 지정사업, passage names unchanged. Contradictory labels for identical inputs intentionally remove target information.

inputs: All conditions replace every parser-found amount by 0원; original values/offsets are side records only. Canonicalization consults query/text alone, no gold spans, roles, entities, evidence, or labels. It is a deterministic exact-string transformation, NOT learned entity linking.
model: v3 evidence reader, upper two encoder layers and heads trainable, unchanged losses. CUDA fp16 training with overflow skips recorded; fp32 inference. Last epoch, no checkpoint selection.
data: Train960/validation192/evaluation384 (480/96/192 passages with two queries each). All24 target classes trained. Train event-pair offsets1,7,11,13,19; validation/evaluation5,17. Names and event/state wording families differ by split; same author and finite grammar. Both targets and positions balanced. Rewrites share evaluation events.
evaluation: primary: both queries jointly correct for axes and all amounts, per paired passage
row joint, axes, roles, evidence character F1
other-to-target attachment counts and target role errors
per lexical family and all three seeds; no IID row confidence interval
interleaved and former/latter reference transfer; unseen layouts
swapped block order and value-preserving unit rewrite
target absent192: all amounts other, relation/state unspecified; forced output and selective gating
gate: v3 threshold 0.00..0.99, at least20 validation answers with joint error<=5%, choose maximum coverage. If none, answer none. No evaluation tuning.
paired_invariance: Unit rewrites should have identical neural inputs by construction; query-blind pair outputs should be identical; report correctness separately.
controls: Compare new marked vs new plain for combined canonicalization intervention; legacy vs new changes training content and inference padding from v4, so not a single-factor training-data causal proof. All v5 conditions use fixed192 fp32 inference. The marker also removes target lexical identity, so cannot isolate marker position from anonymization.

display_example.reason: first evaluation passage fixed before inference; show both queries and actual predictions

stop: Nine new fits (3 inputs x 3 seeds), two inference views of three existing weights. Last epoch only; no result-dependent hyperparameter or data tuning. Preserve failures.
limits: No new official document collection, no human gold, no speaker-resolution model, no two-document version matching, no learned arithmetic. Exact matching can miss aliases and match substrings; query overlapping money unsupported. This experiment only tests the written inputs. A marker method is not novel by itself.
